summary.en: Two parties in cards and the shared ruler between them, then a big counter steps to N, the camera pushing in on the count, a meta column, and a ticker of the counted items with their verdict.
summary.zh: 两张卡片上的双方和它们之间共用的尺子，然后大计数器一步步走到 N，镜头推近计数，旁边一列补充信息，底部滚动条重复被数的条目和结论。

fits: A comparison that ends in a number: two machines, two teams, before and after, all checked against one thing.
notFor: More than 16 counted items; a comparison without a shared ruler; numbers that are not counts.

intent.en: Prove agreement by counting: both sides checked against the same thing, one at a time, until the number lands.
intent.zh: 用计数证明一致：双方对着同一个标准逐项核对，直到数字落定。

content.en: The header, left and right parties (label, name, desc, ≤ 3 items), the shared middle (label, name, desc), the counted items (≤ 16) with a label and verdict, ≤ 3 meta lines.
content.zh: 页眉、左右双方（标签、名称、说明、≤ 3 条）、中间共用项（标签、名称、说明）、被数的条目（≤ 16）及标签和结论、≤ 3 行补充。

fits.zh: 以一个数字结尾的对比：两台机器、两个团队、改前改后，都对照同一个标准。

notFor.zh: 超过 16 个计数条目；没有共同标准的对比；不是计数的数字。

en: The counter steps through whole numbers only; digits never flicker through other digits.
zh: 计数器只走整数；数字不会闪过别的数字。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
